objectives.title: Understand and use Databricks and its machine learning capabilities like AutoML, Unity Catalog and select features of MLflow
Explore data and perform feature engineering
Model building through training, tuning and evaluation and selection

exam_rules: Closed-book. No notes or Databricks workspace access. Proctor monitors via webcam.
id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID with full name. Name must match Webassessor registration exactly.

official_study_resources.notes: Official Databricks training courses aligned to certification exams
official_study_resources.title: Databricks Academy

official_study_resources.notes: Free practice questions available on each certification page
official_study_resources.title: Databricks Certification Practice Exams

recommended_experience: 6+ months of hands-on experience performing the machine learning tasks outlined in the exam guide
renewal_options: Certifications valid for 2 years. Renew by retaking the current version of the exam.

retake_policy.notes: 14-day waiting period after failed attempt. Full exam fee required for retake.
